# odin_builder
A simple utility for writing build scripts in Odin

An example of how to write a build script with this can be found in `example/build.odin`.

## Generated files

Odin build options and targets are generated based on the usage text generated by the compiler.

To regenerate the Odin build options, run: `odin run tools/generate_odin_build_options.odin -file`
To regenerate the Odin build targets, run: `odin run tools/generate_odin_targets.odin -file`
